title: LodTiles
description:
The level-of-detail tiles of a worldspace that the setup has: the
blocks of land the game shows from a distance (ADR 0037).

world.description: The worldspace, by its internal name.

LodTile.description: One block of level of detail.

level.description: How many cells the block covers in each direction: 4, 8, 16 or 32.

objects.description: Whether the block has objects: towns, castles, bridges, rocks.

x.description: The cell column at its south-west corner.

y.description: The cell row at its south-west corner.
